scripts.dev: turbo run build --filter=./packages/* && dotenv -e .env -- turbo run dev
scripts.db:seed: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @repo/db seed && dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @repo/auth seed:dev
scripts.compose:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile dev up -d
scripts.compose:dev:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile dev down
scripts.compose:all: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile all up -d --build
scripts.compose:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile all up -d --build
